newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil closes down on bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil closes down on bearish sentiment.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Nov (3rd pos) 1,189 rgt/tonne Sep (south) 1,210 *
Open/Hi/low 1,208/1,208/1,182 Prev close 1,240
Prev settlement 1,217 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - A weak Chicago soyoil close due to a bearish USDA crop report and technical selling dragged prices down. Trading was nerous with some panic selling seen when Nov futures broke the 1,200 ringgit support level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Concern over Pakistan's buying in near-term and selling affected sentiment. Interest was seen among nearby crude palm oil selected products.
But the contract managed to find some support at the lower levels and it closed 28 ringgit down at 1,189 ringgit ($475.79) a tonne. The next support level will be 1,180 ringgit.
"Prices were marked down because of a lower soyoil market and speculation of lesser imports by Pakistan," a dealer said.

Pakistan on Tuesday devalued the rupee by 3.79 percent, making imports more expensive. "The rupee devaluation has prompted caution and people are concern over Pakistan imports in coming month," a dealer added.

Traders said the market is also waiting for fresh fundamental news, with Malaysian private forecaster, Ivan Wong due to release his final August's output/export/stock figures on Friday before the release of official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority data on Monday.
Plantation houses estimated that output in August have risen by up to 10 percent over July's 721,893 tonnes due to seasonal upward trend in production.
Turnover was 2,280 lots against 1,884 lots on Wednesday.
Interest among physical was confined to selected products and nearby crude palm oil.
Sep (south) crude palm oil was quoted sellers at 1,210 ringgit a tonne after trading at 1,210. Sep (south) saw bids at 1,200.
Sep (central) was offered at 1,200 with bids at 1,180. Sep (north) saw offers at 1,190 and bids at 1,175.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,215 ringgit with bids at 1,200. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,205 and bids at 1,185 and Nov (south) at 1,225 with bids at 1,205.
In refined products, Sep RBD palmoil was offered at $522.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $520.
Sep palm olein saw offers at $560, Oct at $552.50 and Nov/Dec at $542.50. Oct was traded from $553 to $548, and Nov/Dec from $545 to $539.
Sep RBD pam stearin was offered at $412.50 and Oct at $417.50. Sep palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $340 and Oct/Nov at $342.50.
